## RE:volution Mod v1.4.8

### Added

- Added Balance Export Contract v1 as a deterministic read-only projection of the active Balance Core snapshot.
- Added authenticated `GET /api/v1/balance/export` under the existing `balance.read` capability.
- Added export metadata with contract version, active revision, Balance Core schema version and authoritative canonical JSON.
- Added spreadsheet-friendly deterministic rows using RFC 6901 JSON Pointers with explicit `string`, `number`, `boolean` and `null` value types.
- Added regression coverage for inactive-state rejection, deterministic equivalent configs, canonical decimal formatting, arrays and JSON Pointer escaping.

### Fixed

- External balance tooling no longer needs to infer a table shape from internal Java structures or introduce a second balance state to prepare data for export.
- Balance IDs containing `/` or `~` can be represented unambiguously in the tabular projection through RFC 6901 escaping.

### Other

- `canonicalConfig` and `revision` remain the source of truth; exported rows are a read-only convenience projection.
- Existing Balance Preview/Apply, gameplay balance values, persistence schema and write permissions are unchanged.
- The gameplay mod does not connect to Google APIs, OAuth or store external integration credentials; Google Sheets integration remains an external-tool concern.
- The next planned gameplay step is v1.4.9 Rune Rank Revert.

### Download

Use the matching server and client gameplay artifact published for this stable release.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.4.7...v1.4.8
